landing.faqTrustA: Owners confirm every 10–14 days that the space is still available. If they don't confirm within 72 hours, the listing is hidden. Every card shows “Confirmed 3 days ago”.

landing.faqOwnersA: Yes. {share}% of listings here come from owners. The “Owners only” filter hides broker listings, and broker commission is always shown.
